featured_reviews.name: Danish Husain
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Nightmarish Experience with the HP Spectre 13 purchased from the store.

Regrettably, I'm compelled to award the minimum of 1 star, else, it would be none. My purchase of the HP 13 Spectre, touted as a "premium category" laptop by the salesperson, has proven to be a colossal disappointment.

In early June of this year, I invested in this laptop with the expectation of solid support throughout my MBA program. However, this device has only hindered my academic journey. Less than a month into its use, unsightly blots and marks marred the screen, as visible in the accompanying image. To add insult to injury, the repair process was painful when I went to the store with a valid warranty since it occurred only a month after purchase. There was even mention that charges might be levied for a screen replacement even though it was an internal issue and no external damage had taken place. After persistent requests, it was finally being done for no charges but the screen replacement took an eternity, leaving me laptop-less during crucial coursework affecting my performance but I was helpless.

Now, five months post-replacement, the laptop is a glitch-ridden, unbalanced mess, the hinges also seem unbalanced and it is always slightly tilted. Its touted "premium feature," the 360-degree mode, is a farce since it randomly shuts off when put in tablet mode, I discovered this only today because up till now I was too scared to even bend the laptop thinking the delicate darling would break.

This might just be chalked up to sheer bad luck that I received a faulty piece exacerbated by a late delivery in the first place but never before had I invested such a substantial amount in a laptop, and the regret is palpable.

Purchasing from this store, with its abysmal after-sales service, was a grievous mistake. I hope the luck for others isn't that bad and in hindsight, I should have considered the nearby Vijay Sales.

The prospect of returning to the store for further fixes is met with despair. I've lost hope, as I feel if I go then I'll just have to pay more to fix it and I cannot afford that after such an expensive laptop. It would also come at a loss of further hindrance during my coursework as again ages would be taken to fix it.
An automated reply would be a futile exercise, as my faith in the store's ability to rectify its mistakes has evaporated.
